name: ServiceNow
hiring_system: smartrecruiters (company ServiceNow; careers.servicenow.com is an Umbraco 'jobboard' marketing copy)
feed: GET https://careers.smartrecruiters.com/ServiceNow + /ServiceNow/api/groups?page=1..16 + /ServiceNow/api/more?type=location&value=<v>&page=N (HTML), unioned with GET https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/sr-jobs/search?limit=100&company=ServiceNow (JSON, newest 100 + totalFound)
page_total_how: Playwright render of https://careers.servicenow.com/jobs/ (no filters): 'Displaying 1 to 20 of 676 matching jobs'. SmartRecruiters' own search index (sr-jobs/search totalFound) said 677/678 the same hour. The hosted SmartRecruiters career page sums to 688 (99 location groups, data-qty); my crawl collected 687 unique + 1 found only via sr-jobs/search.
robots: ALLOW (careers.smartrecruiters.com/robots.txt serves an HTML page = no rules; jobs.smartrecruiters.com/robots.txt is 404). api.smartrecruiters.com is BLOCK (Disallow: /) and is not used.
notes: Hosted career page is a superset of the site: all 20 jobs on the site's first page and 98 of the 99 newest search results were in the crawl (the 99th was dropped by unstable ordering inside a location group). The remaining ~11 extra postings (688 vs 676/677) could not be identified within the request budget. Crawl = 57 requests. careers.servicenow.com answers plain clients with a Cloudflare challenge (403), so its Umbraco GetJobs is not usable.
